name: Crypt Fencer
description: A ceremonial guard who remembers only the final lesson of her fencing school. She answers every third exchange with a practiced guard.

abilities.description: Restores 7 temporary block every third round. Any remainder expires afterward.
Up to 1 damage per strike bypasses block after slow, plating and resistance reduce the strike.
